notes: v4.4.0 release: US wait-time persistence FIXED (was broken since v4.1.0 — the processor referenced slots.id/metadata/expires_at which never existed; now a dedicated wait_times table). Default targets now merge all 36 US consulate cities into one monitored target instead of keeping only the first. state.gov parsing understands the real table layout. RFC3339 timestamps. aiohttp server import fixed. Telegram chunking under the 4096-char limit. New CLI: wait-times, export, doctor. Generic webhook channel. v4.3.0 release: instant notifications on PAGE CHANGED (no more 26-min lag from cycle-end batching), fake_useragent log suppression, bytecode caching disabled to prevent stale .pyc on version upgrades. India-outbound visa application centers, indexed by (destination_country x processor). v4.2.0 release: extended us_state_dept processor to 30 third-country US consulates (Mexico 10, Canada 7, UAE 2, Saudi 2, plus Singapore/Thailand/UK/France/Germany/Australia/Japan). Added accent-handling for non-ASCII consulate names. New INTERNATIONALIZATION_GUIDE.md for non-Indian users. Schengen documentation enhanced (no Schengen wait-time tracker — VFS layer is the right mechanism, validated for Czech Republic May 2026). v4.1.0 release: added 5 US consulate entries (Mumbai, New Delhi, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata) using new us_state_dept processor for wait-time tracking via state.gov + CGI Federal public pages. v4.0.0 release: added _indian_passport_status flags to 7 visa-free and 5 e-visa destinations, default 'tier' field on all centers, tier system (hot/warm/cold). v3.2.4 release: no structural changes; version bump for consistency. v3.2.3 release: consolidates v3.2.2a-d hotfixes. v3.2.2 added noise-marker schema, rate-limited notifications, delta classifier. v3.2.1 corrected four misclassified processors.

vfs_global.name: VFS Global
vfs_global.notes: Largest visa processor. Nuxt SPA — hydration wait required. Headquartered Dubai, formerly India. Handles UK, most Schengen, Australia, Canada, China, and 60+ other destinations from India.
vfs_global.api_notes: Both endpoints are JWT-protected behind Cloudflare. Anonymous fetch returns 403. To use them: open the country's portal in Selenium, complete the category/center selection, harvest the Authorization JWT from network logs or localStorage, then POST to /appointment/slots with countryCode='ind', missionCode=<iso3>, centerCode=<VAC code>, visaCategoryCode=<varies>, languageCode='en-US', applicantsCount=1, days=90, slotType=2.

bls_international.name: BLS International
bls_international.notes: Indian-origin processor (Forbes Asia Best Under a Billion). ASP.NET classic stack. Mainly Spain (8 cities), Slovakia, Portugal, parts of Italy and Czech.

tls_contact.name: TLScontact
tls_contact.notes: Teleperformance-owned. Smaller India footprint than VFS. React SPA. Each destination on its own portal — accounts not shared across countries.

cgi_federal.name: CGI Federal (USTravelDocs)
cgi_federal.notes: Sole processor for US non-immigrant visas from India. Aggressively rate-limited and CAPTCHA-protected. Scraping against this carries account-lock risk. KEEP DISABLED unless you have explicit consent and rotation infrastructure.

ckgs.name: Cox & Kings Global Services
ckgs.notes: Indian processor. Now mostly handles US passport services, OCI, and some onward routes. Reduced scope vs earlier years.

embassy_direct.name: Embassy Direct (no outsourcing)
embassy_direct.notes: Some embassies process applications without an outsourced VAC — Bhutan, Maldives, Nepal, Iran (some categories), and others. URLs vary.

indian_visa_online.name: Indian Visa Online (gov.in)
indian_visa_online.notes: Government of India eVisa portal — for foreign nationals applying TO India. Inverse direction from the rest of this registry.

us_state_dept.name: US Department of State + CGI Federal (wait-time tracker)
us_state_dept.notes: v4.1.0 — Complementary to cgi_federal entry. Tracks official wait-time data for US consulates from travel.state.gov (monthly updates) + ais.usvisa-info.com/en-in/niv/information/visa_wait_times (more frequent). Pure HTTP, no Selenium, no captcha. Detects significant drops which correlate with new appointment slots being released. Latency: days to weeks (not minutes like VFS). NOT a real-time slot scraper — direct slot scraping at CGI Federal requires DS-160 + paid receipt + login and is intentionally NOT implemented (account-lock risk). See US_VISA_GUIDE.md for context on usage.

_indian_passport_status_legend.visa_free: Indian passport holders enter visa-free or visa-on-arrival. No appointment slot to monitor. enabled is forced to false. To re-enable for other passports, change enabled to true.
_indian_passport_status_legend.evisa: E-visa with instant or near-instant approval. No appointment slot to monitor. See _status_note for the actual application URL.
_indian_passport_status_legend.appointment_required: Standard visa requiring an appointment at a VFS / BLS / consulate slot. Monitor normally.

_third_country_interview_legend: v4.2.0 — Some Indian US visa applicants pursue interviews at non-Indian US consulates when domestic queues exceed 1+ year. This is called the 'third-country national' (TCN) workaround. Most Mexican consulates accept TCNs when not overbooked. Canadian consulates restricted TCN post-2023 but still useful for trend tracking. Gulf consulates (UAE, Saudi) are useful for Indians on Gulf work visas. All entries are DISABLED by default — opt in via `select-countries` if relevant.
